• Are you having trouble with these symptoms?
  • What is anti-wrinkle hyaluronic acid injection?
  • Expected effects of hyaluronic acid injections
  • Side effects, downtime and disadvantages of hyaluronic acid injections
  • Cost of hyaluronic acid injection performed at our hospital

Are you having trouble with these symptoms?

  • I'm starting to notice wrinkles on my forehead, between my eyebrows, and around the corners of my eyes.
  • Fine lines have become noticeable
  • My skin has lost its firmness and moisture
  • The roundness of the forehead is gone
  • The hollows on my temples have become noticeable.
  • I want to feel the effects immediately
  • Resistant to treatment using a scalpel
  • I want to tackle aging care in an easy way.

What is anti-wrinkle hyaluronic acid injection?

Hyaluronic acid keeps skin moisturized

Hyaluronic acid is a substance that originally exists in our bodies. It is jelly-like, has strong viscosity and elasticity, and primarily functions to connect cells in various areas such as the dermis, skin, muscles, and cartilage.
The main component of the dermis is collagen, which serves as the foundation for support. It has excellent moisturizing power, so it is essential for maintaining skin moisture and firmness.

What is hyaluronic acid injection?

Hyaluronic acid injection is a treatment that restores skin moisture and firmness by injecting hyaluronic acid into the dermis. By providing moisture and firmness, you can also expect to improve wrinkles, including fine lines.
It can be injected directly into the area of concern, and you can feel the effects immediately.

Expected effects of hyaluronic acid injections

Injection application site for hyaluronic acid injection

By injecting hyaluronic acid directly into the following areas, you can restore moisture and firmness to your skin. Various effects can be expected depending on the injection site, such as making wrinkles less noticeable, giving a youthful roundness to the forehead and cheeks, raising the nose, and adjusting the shape of the chin and lips.

  • forehead
  • temple
  • Between the eyebrows
  • tear bag
  • corner of the eye
  • nose
  • cheek
  • nasolabial folds
  • lips
  • chin

When can I feel the effects? How long does it last?

You can feel the effects immediately after injection of hyaluronic acid. Although there are individual differences, the effects last for about six months to a year.
Therefore, to maintain the effect, we recommend undergoing treatment every six months to one year.

Effective way to take hyaluronic acid

There are also supplements and lotions that contain hyaluronic acid on the market.
However, supplements take a long time to feel their effects, and lotion only has a superficial moisturizing effect on the skin.
With hyaluronic acid injections, you can feel the effects immediately because it is injected directly. Another advantage that supplements and lotions do not have is that it can be injected precisely into the areas of concern.

Side effects, downtime and disadvantages of hyaluronic acid injections

side effects

  • Temporary internal bleeding, edema, and mild pain at the injection site
  • Swelling at the injection site (this is due to the anesthetic and will subside after 2-3 days)

Downtime and precautions

  • If there is no bleeding, you can wash your face, put on makeup, take a bath, and exercise on the day of the procedure.
  • Please refrain from strong facial massage for about 2 weeks.
  • If you experience severe pain at the injection site, or pain or redness around the injection site after returning home, please contact us immediately. Blood circulation may be impaired.

Disadvantages

  • Hyaluronic acid is absorbed within six months to a year. Therefore, regular injections are required to maintain its effectiveness.
  • Inexperienced doctors may misjudge the amount of injection, resulting in unnatural results. Get treatment from a doctor you trust.

Clarification of information related to safety in other countries

In Japan, this product has not been approved under the Pharmaceutical and Medical Device Act.

About the acquisition route

All items are purchased from domestic distributors.
*Reference: Ministry of Health, Labor and Welfare's guidance regarding personal imports

https://www.yakubutsu.mhlw.go.jp/individualimport/healthhazard/

Other domestically approved drugs with the same ingredients and efficacy

There are no other domestically approved drugs that have the same ingredients and performance. *This will be a free medical treatment.
